items.title: Lanterns Star Aaron Pierre Addresses His DCU Future: 'What Will Be Will Be'
items.excerpt: Lanterns star Aaron Pierre had already reprised his role as Green Lantern John Stewart for the 2027 film Man of Tomorrow when the news broke that DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran had been fired by new parent company Skydance. Whether his appearance will remain in the final film now that there’s a new regime in charge of DC, Pierre says, “I’m very at peace. What will be will be.”
items.content_text: Lanterns star Aaron Pierre had already reprised his role as Green Lantern John Stewart for the 2027 film Man of Tomorrow when the news broke that DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran had been fired by new parent company Skydance. Whether his appearance will remain in the final film now that there’s a new regime in charge of DC, Pierre says, “I’m very at peace. What will be will be.” In a podcast chat with IndieWire recorded the same day the news about Gunn and Safran broke, Pierre says, “Well, I actually only just found out the news prior to logging on so I haven’t very much time at all to process the enormity of that news. But what I can say is that my relationship with James and my relationship with Peter is a beautiful relationship and I’ve really loved every moment collaborating with them and working with them and getting to know them. And I’m excited to, beyond this point, in a different context, collaborate with them again and I’m also excited to see what happens next for DC.” The Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow was in post-production when Gunn and Safran were removed from their posts. It didn’t take long for the online rumor mill to flood the internet with claims that Skydance was going to remove many of the cameos from Man of Tomorrow, namely Supergirl and Blue Beetle . John Stewart is among the DC heroes set to appear in the film. Gunn, though, shot down all such claims of studio meddling , stating that no one at Skydance has even seen the film yet. "There are a lot of untrue rumors going around, but one of them is that Skydance has seen Man of Tomorrow and that all sorts of sweeping changes are being made," Gunn posted. "No one from Skydance has even seen the movie - the only people that have are Peter Safran and a very small trusted group of friends and family. So any stories around this narrative are false." It remains unclear what DC Studios’ future looks like until Jeremy Latcham , the incoming President and Chief Creative Officer of DC Studios, takes his post on December 1. For his part, Pierre is remaining zen about what’s in store for Man of Tomorrow and DC’s future. (The status of Lanterns Season 2 also remains up in the air .) “I think for me, you know, we did the film and we really loved every moment of doing the film and what happens beyond this point is not my decision. So I’m very at peace,” Pierre tells IndieWire. “What will be will be. But what I do know is that those friendships will last beyond this point and also those artistic creative, working collaboration relationships will live beyond this point as well. And as I say, I’m excited to see where DC goes from here.” Until Latcham says otherwise, fans can only suspect things are back to square one again lest they heed some fans’ advice not to reboot the DCU again . If that’s it for Gunn and Safran’s “Gods and Monsters” saga then why should fans be invested in Man of Tomorrow if it no longer matters ? It will likely just collapse at the box office like The Flash did after Gunn ended the DCEU.
items.title_en: Lanterns Star Aaron Pierre Addresses His DCU Future: 'What Will Be Will Be'

items.content_text: Dell makes some of the best gaming monitors around under the Alienware brand. Its OLED monitors are no different. You will need to sign up for a Dell Rewards membership, which is free to join. 27" Alienware AW2726DM QHD QD-OLED Gaming Monitor Most people would agree that OLED monitors are as good as it gets for gaming. They're also really expensive. Well, Alienware is bucking the trend with one of its latest 2026 OLED releases. The 27" Alienware AW2726DM QHD 240Hz QD-OLED gaming monitor is listed at an already reasonable retail price of $349.99, but for Black Friday it's down to just $279.99 with free shipping. This is a 27" 2560x1440 (QHD) monitor that incorporates a Samsung quantum dot OLED ( QD OLED ) panel, which is brighter and has a wider color gamut than the more commonly found W-OLED panel. 39" Alienware AW3926QW 5K RGB Tandem Stripe OLED Monitor Earlier this year, Dell announced the "world's first 39" 5K monitor with RGB stripe tandem OLED technology."It launched with a retail price of $1,099.99 but for Black Friday you can get it for $100 less . The Alienware AW3926QW has no lack of features that make it stand out from the crowd, but perhaps its most impressive inclusion is the LG RGB stripe tandem OLED panel. Tandem OLED stacks multiple OLED layers on top of each other instead of a single layer. Tandem OLED is better than other OLED panels because: 1) it's much brighter (the AW3926QW in particular has a very impressive 1,300 nits of peak brightness) and 2) it's less prone to burn-in. The AW3926QW doubles down on this with new RGB stripe technology. Whereas traditional tandem OLEDs use white pixels, RGB stripe tandem OLED breaks the color down further into vertically aligned red, green, and blue pixels. This reduces color fringing and in turn significantly improves text clarity. It goes without saying that there are obvious benefits here for both gaming and productivity purposes alike. 32" Alienware AW3225QF 4K 240Hz QD-OLED Gaming Monitor Alienware's most popular 4K OLED gaming monitor is also down to its lowest price ever. For Black Friday, you can pick up a 32" Alienware AW3225QF 4K QD OLED gaming monitor for just $699.99 with free shipping. The AW3225QF is a rare gaming monitor that combines a native 4K resolution, 240Hz refresh rate , and a gorgeous Samsung-sourced quantum dot OLED panel. If you're looking for the best 4K gaming monitor , this should definitely be on your short list. The Alienware AW3225QF is HDR True Black 400 certified with up to 1,000 nits of peak brightness. It also boasts a factory calibrated 99.3% DCI-P3 color range, 1700R curve, and G-Sync certification . 32" Alienware AW3226Q 4K RGB Tandem Stripe OLED Monitor The 32" Alienware AW3226Q gaming monitor is another recent release that's aimed toward the more budget-conscious crowd. The monitor launched about a month ago at a very reasonable $699.99 price tag, but it's already $50 off ahead of Black Friday. Unlike the slighty more expensive AW3225QF which uses a curved 240Hz QD-OLED panel from Samsung, the Alienware AW3226Q is equipped with a flat panel 165Hz RGB stripe tandem OLED panel from LG. In exchange for a lower refresh rate and no official G-Sync certification (it's still G-Sync compatible), you get better text clarity and arguably a better monitor for non-gaming use. items.title: GTA 6 Has Police Departments Across America Begging People Not to Commit Crimes IRL
items.excerpt: GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit real crimes.
items.content_text: GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit real crimes. GTA 6 is finally here, and you can carry out many of your wildest criminal fantasies. It's a very freeing experience, and Rockstar has added more depth than ever before to make crimes like simple robberies more intricate and nuanced. However, the usual suspects when it comes to a new GTA game (mainstream news outlets, like Fox News ) have expressed concern over what kind of impact this might have on society. Will it create real rampant crime or spikes in violence? Probably not, but police departments across the country have created PSAs to ask people not to commit crime. The Atlanta Police Department put out a post asking people to express their more radical desires in-game and not in real life. GTA is not a real place, but Atlanta is!🎮 Don't confuse virtual entertainment with real-life decisions. Drunk driving, reckless driving, auto theft and violence have real consequences. Keep it in the game. Don't bring it to our streets. https://t.co/Y7PdJFHLsZ — Atlanta Police Department (@Atlanta_Police) November 17, 2026 The police department in San Juan, Texas have asked players to keep their behavior in-game, noting that a six star wanted level in real life is not a challenge, but a criminal jail sentence. It's a bit of fun to likely ride the GTA 6 hype wave. You'd be hard pressed to find a major company that isn't trying to capture GTA 6's excitement in some way right now, and it seems like even local governments are doing the same thing. As is always the case with GTA, there are some folks expressing concern over the game's contents. One concerned group in particular is the furry community , which is mocked in-game. Furries are illegal in GTA 6 and as a result, the police hunt them down and point weapons at them. It's pretty absurd, but some real furries don't find it very amusing. This is all par for the course for this franchise, but it does seem like more non-gamers are trying to have fun with it since it's such a massive cultural event. As of right now, we don't know how well GTA 6 has sold, but it looks like it's going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history. Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? items.content_text: Apple has officially revealed its streaming deal for 2026 and it's the best discount we've seen so far on an ad-free plan. New and eligible returning subscribers can get Apple TV for $6.99 per month for the first six months of their subscription. This is half the price of what the service usually costs, thanks to a fairly recent price increase bumping monthly plans up to $14.99/mo. This promotion is available now and is currently set to end on November 30, 2026 at precisely 8pm PT. If you're hoping to save on streaming subscriptions heading into next year, this deal is a great way to do so. Just make sure you grab it before the end of Cyber Monday. Apple TV Black Friday Deal Details Apple TV has seen a pretty drastic price increase since it first launched, but it makes sense when you look at the number of high-quality original shows are on the platform now. You've got massive hits like Severance and Ted Lasso as well as some of the best new sci-fi shows like Silo and Murderbot. If you've never had an Apple TV subscription, there's a lot of really good TV you could watch in that six-month window. If you're a returning subscriber, there's plenty to look forward to on the service as well. The slate of November releases includes Owen Wilson's golf series and a feel-good Chris Pratt movie. items.title: Save 33% Off the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 Sport Headphone With Bone Conduction Tech for Black Friday
items.content_text: If you enjoy listening to music while you run or work out, then you should consider getting a headset that's specifically designed for it. Shokz is one of the best known and well-respected sport headphone brands and, fortunately for you, the Shokz Black Friday Sale has officially kicked off on Amazon . As part of this sale, Amazon has dropped the price of the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 open-ear wireless sport headphones in rose gold from $180 to just $119.99 with free shipping. All other colorways are on sale for $125, so stick with rose gold for the biggest savings. The OpenRun Pro 2 uses bone conduction technology to transmit sound without covering your ears. 33% Off the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 Sport Headphones The OpenRun Pro 2 looks like a neckband style headphone except that a lightweight titanium band connecting the two ear pieces wraps around the back of your head instead of resting on your neck. This design does an excellent job of keeping everything in place, perfect for active exercise. Instead of the traditional method of sending sound vibrations to your eardrums, the OpenRun Pro uses bone conduction technology to send vibrations through your cheekbones directly to your inner ear. As such, the headphones are actually placed in front of your ear instead of on your ear. The biggest advantage is that you can fully hear your surroundings; if you like running on streets, for example, you'll be aware of everything that's going on around you while your music is playing. OpenRun Pro 2 is an obvious upgrade over the Open Run Pro The OpenRun Pro 2 is a substantial update over its predecessor. The most noticeable upgrade is arguably the switch from a proprietary magnetic charging cable to the USB Type-C standard. Another significant upgrade is the sound quality. While the original OpenRun Pro has good bass response, it is slightly hampered by the fact that it produces tiny vibrations that are noticeable and sometimes ticklish or distracting. The new OpenRun Pro 2 utilizes Shok's DualPitch technology to virtually eliminate vibrations. Other smaller changes include increased battery life and improved mic quality. The Shokz OpenRun are the best earbuds for exercise I have a pair of AirPods Pro that I use regularly, but I always set them aside for the OpenRun Pros when I run. The Transparency mode on the AirPods Pro does work well for most situations, but they still can't compare to the awareness you get without having any buds plugging up your ears. In my experience these headphones stay in place extremely well and the sound quality is great compared to other sport headphones I've tried. items.title: GTA 6's Viral NPC May Actually Have a Dark Secret
items.excerpt: A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral since the game's launch for being a total smokeshow, but she also seems to have a dark secret.
items.content_text: Warning: Spoilers for GTA 6 ahead! A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral for being a total smokeshow, but fans are also noticing that she seems to have a dark secret. Early on in the game, Brian sends Jason to go retrieve rent from a tenant named Mandy, who refuses to pay until her sink is fixed. Once you get there, it's clear she has staged a maintenance emergency so Jason would turn up. She's madly obsessed with him, but Jason pays no mind, since he's still pursuing Lucia. She eventually tries to seduce Jason with a skimpy bikini, to no avail. He ends up pulling out whatever is lodged in her sink, which she quickly takes and runs off with. Mandy eventually gets irritated with Jason's disinterest and kicks him out, but if players linger around the property, they may start to realize Mandy isn't just obsessive because she has a crush... but because she may be a killer. If you wander into her backyard, you will see a freshly covered-up, body-sized hole next to a few tubs of acid. But hey, maybe it's just a coincidence! If you pop the trunk of her car, you will also see more acid and tools someone might use to kidnap and kill a person. And if you take a quick look at what was in Mandy's sink, it appears to be a severed finger. While it's unclear if she's actually a serial killer (it takes three victims to be classified as one, by the way), she does appear to have killed at least one person. It's unclear who the other guy is, but it's possible Jason could've met a similar fate. Does she seduce people in order to kill them? Or does she kill them because they reject her advances or hurt her emotionally? It's hard to say. Either way, it seems clear that there's definitely a screw loose, and it's good that Jason didn't fall for her seduction. Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? items.content_text: When the Steam Machine first came out in June, it was in short supply, due to the limited amount of hardware Valve was able to get its hands on (thanks, RAM crisis). Now, about 5 months after launch, you can finally just buy a Steam Machine. Valve put out a blog post on November 19 giving an update on Steam Machine reservations, revealing that it had just finished out sending purchase invites to anyone on the reservation list for the 2TB model. The 512GB version, though, is now available to purchase on the Steam store page without a reservation. However, it looks like Valve doesn't have the components on hand to make the 2TB model available in the same way. According to Valve's blog, the ongoing memory shortage is particularly impacting the 2TB Steam Machine because of its much larger drive. The company says the amount of people on the waitlist for the 2TB Machine exceeds what there were able to make, and while it's going to make more, it's going to be at a limited rate. Still, Valve was able to get through its 512GB Steam Machine waitlist much earlier than expected. When the mini PC launched, some people were placed on the waitlist with an expected order time of 2027. Luckily, the new year hasn't ticked over, and the Machine is now available to buy for anyone that wants it... but there is a possibility that Valve will sell through its entire supply. Valve does say that it's going to continue to build the Machine, but it sounds like the production run is going to be limited. It says that "memory and storage costs continue to increase at unprecedented levels; as a result, we don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price we'll be able to offer them." It's no secret that the RAM crisis has been particularly unforgiving to the Steam Machine, and it's not likely to let up in the near future. Samsung told investors in an earnings call last month that it expects supply to be more constrained next year, and all three of the major RAM manufacturers have sold through their manufacturing capacity through next year. It doesn't seem likely that the memory and storage costs that are limiting how many Steam Machines Valve can make will let up at all in the near future. From the way that blog post ended by saying it doesn't know how many Steam Machines it can make or how expensive they're going to be, it's very likely that the mini PC is either going to get a hearty price rise in January, or just be discontinued until Valve can make a followup when prices go down. Either way, it's a shame – the Steam Machine is an excellent little computer, and the RAM crisis unfortunately made it a non-starter for a lot of people, due to the price.

items.title: Video Game Spending Dropped 14% This October, Possibly Because Everyone Was Preparing for GTA 6
items.excerpt: The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that this coincided with the release of GTA 6 in November.
items.content_text: The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that this coincided with the release of GTA 6 in November. A new report from market research firm Circana shows that gamers were a bit more frugal this October than they were last year, despite two major games releasing that month. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched on October 23, and Gears of War: E-Day released on October 1. Both games enjoyed reasonable critical reception, though reviews for Modern Warfare 4 were rather mixed . It’s worth noting that sales for E-Day paled in comparison to the rave reviews it received, with analysts estimating that the game only sold 400,000 copies across both console and PC as of October 30. And last October, Battlefield 6 rocked players’ wallets as one of the best-selling games in the entire series — and, indeed, the best-selling game of the entire year — so it’s not a head-scratcher that this was a tough act for MW4 and E-Day to follow. Circana’s report found that consumer spending on console, specifically, fell 18% from last year, and compared this trend to sales from Battlefield 6 and Pokémon Legends: Z-A . The report pointed to a 16% decline in mobile spending as the primary driver of this drop in addition to Battlefield's booming sales from last October. However, it’s hard to ignore the impact that GTA 6 has had on the industry at large. Earlier this month, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick revealed that the release of the world’s most highly anticipated game likely had an impact on the lower-than-expected sales for NBA 2K27, as well as other titles. “I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far,” he told IGN in an exclusive interview . “It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.” The launch of GTA 6 has proven to be a massive and unprecedented moment in pop culture history, to the point where analysts saw a 17% increase in time off requests for its release date on November 19. Even world governments were hopping on the bandwagon, with Australia’s workplace regulator reminding employees of their rights to PTO in a viral post last month. Germany also boasts a program that allows workers to take time off for professional development to play the game. If that wasn’t wild enough, a U.S. Army Battalion even advertised a special reenlistment incentive that gave service members four days of paid leave that directly coincided with GTA 6’s release, which 43 soldiers ended up taking . It remains to be seen if GTA 6 will really save the average gamer $5,000 by staying indoors, but so many people have hopped online to play that internet service providers reported a massive spike in traffic from Xbox consoles. items.content_text: Crunchyroll has officially unveiled its Black Friday deals for 2026 . The anime streaming service is offering discounts on all three of its ad-free plans, offering between 50% and 60% in monthly savings. Fan plans have dropped from $8.99 to $3.99/month, Mega Fan has dropped from $13.99 to $5.99/month, and the Ultimate Fan tier has dropped from $17.99 to $8.99/month. Crunchyroll has made a number of changes to its subscription model over the past year, with a big emphasis on the brand’s features outside of streaming. Read on for a breakdown of what’s currently included in each plan. Crunchyroll Black Friday Deals - Each Tier Explained The big shift in Crunchyroll’s streaming set-up started when the service removed its free streaming tier at the end of last year. Soon after, the service increased prices while moving some features and benefits around to try and justify the hike. If you’re in it for the streaming, no plan has ads and every plan gets simulcasts . Otherwise, here’s how things stand now: Crunchyroll Plans, Explained Crunchyroll Fan basically gets you the Crunchyroll anime library. Note that the deal seemingly removes the option for Crunchyroll’s usual seven-day free trial . If you want to get a better sense of the service before paying up, Crunchyroll is still kind enough to let you at least see its libraries without a subscription. items.content_text: Just Eat is giving away a controller with a button dedicated to ordering food. The 'Stay in the Game' controller features what the food delivery company is calling a 'ChEAT' button under the standard diamond of action buttons. The limited-edition controller is only available through local giveaways in the U.K., and Just Eat has partnered with two local Twitch streamers for the promotion. "When you’re deep into a high-stakes gaming session, nothing kills the moment faster than having to pause the action just to sort out food," said Tina Koehler, Just Eat's UK&I marketing director. "Just Eat has unlocked the ultimate hack to evade the kitchen, enabling gamers to stay just where they are and locked into play." The company’s official UK accounts shared an AI-generated rendering of the controller, shown above, with the orange Just Eat feature on an otherwise very familiar looking peripheral. While the announcement doesn't offer any real information about the controller’s design or compatibility, it certainly looks quite a bit like PlayStation's standard DualSense. Social media has plenty of thoughts about the reveal. While some users think the rendered controller looks surprisingly decent, with one claiming the grips "look better than a stock PS5 controller," others were quick to notice the button’s placement is, well, a little dangerous. If it really did let you order food with the literal hit of a button, a couple slip-ups during a GTA car chase could lead to a pile of chicken nuggets at your door and a big dent in your wallet. items.title: Ubisoft Creates Generative AI Game Studio Called Motherbrain
items.excerpt: Assassin’s Creed developer Ubisoft has created a new subsidiary called Motherbrain, a studio dedicated specifically to the implementation of generative AI in its games.
items.content_text: Assassin’s Creed developer Ubisoft has created a new subsidiary called Motherbrain, a studio dedicated specifically to the implementation of generative AI in games. Ubisoft’s latest earnings report , published on November 19, 2026, included a segment explaining its new operating model. Part of this model is a subsidiary called Motherbrain, which focuses on “AI for gameplay innovation” to “support all game creators in developing groundbreaking experiences.” Further down in its report, Ubisoft reveals that the developers at Motherbrain are also the team behind its first playable, generative AI experience called Teammates. This new AI-focused studio will “develop proprietary technologies for gameplay to empower creators and open up new possibilities for richer, more immersive and engaging player experiences.” Ubisoft explains that Motherbrain is focused on creating “new player experiences, smart NPCs with memory, and AI game masters that manage large-scale systemic worlds.” Motherbrain was founded to “serve creators globally, both within Ubisoft’s Creative House ecosystem and beyond, and form partnerships with selected technology actors.” The existence of Teammates isn’t a surprise; Ubisoft revealed the project late last year, which some members of the media were able to play. It’s described as an immersive first-person shooter where players are accompanied by two robotic AI companions that they can order around using real-time voice commands. Speaking with VideoGamesChronicle , Teammates’ narrative director Virginie Mosser described AI as a “tool,” positing that it isn’t something that will ultimately replace entire swaths of the industry. “It’s a tool first. We’ve been working on it for more than two years now, and our conclusion is that it’s a super cool tool, but it’s still a tool,” she told the outlet. The reveal of this AI-focused studio, however, comes amid sweeping layoffs for those within the games industry. Just today, Ubisoft announced another round of layoffs , hemorrhaging 116 jobs across two of its major studios. And earlier this year, 40 jobs were cut at its Toronto studio, coinciding with a change in leadership with the exit of former creative director Clint Hocking. Currently, Ubisoft is hard at work on the next generation of Assassin’s Creed games, one of those being Project Hexe , a highly-anticipated installment in the series set during the European Witch Trials. News of Ubisoft’s new AI studio follows a few viral AI-related moments within the gaming industry lately; earlier this week, Embark Studios came under fire after replacing esports commentators on a highlight reel with its AI-powered characters from The Finals, and just yesterday, former Take-Two CEO Ben Feder said that the Western game market is just “ one Toy Story moment away from consumer acceptance of AI in video games.” Image Credits: Gabriele Malaspina, Unsplash.com \ Ubisoft

items.excerpt: Doja Cat is extremely unhappy about getting passed over as a featured artist in GTA 6, and she’s making her feelings known in several blistering posts on social media.
items.content_text: Doja Cat is extremely unhappy about getting passed over as a featured artist in GTA 6, and she’s making her feelings known in several blistering posts on social media. GTA 6 , like other games in the series, features several different radio stations that players can scroll through as they zoom down the streets of Vice City. There’s oodles of licensed songs on these stations (we don’t even want to think about how costly this was for Rockstar to pull off), and PinkPantheress even hosts one as a DJ, which, of course, plays some of her music. One artist who wasn’t included in the lineup was Doja Cat — who, as a gamer, was pretty pissed off about apparently getting snubbed by Rockstar for arguably the biggest game of the decade. “I would’ve loved to have my music on GTA 6. I’m so f**kin’ bitter,” she wrote on Twitter/X on November 19. In another, she tagged the official Rockstar account, writing, “Eat my dick all yall, I love your stupid f**kin’ bitch-ass game.” She tagged them again in a third post, saying, “You broke my heart, pinche culero.” As previously mentioned, Doja Cat is an avid gamer. She regularly streams on Twitch between recording new albums and touring, often choosing to play a few games of Fortnite while chatting with her audience. She’s even referenced the game in one of her songs (Agora Hills), and also included a cute line referencing the ‘We got xyz before GTA 6’ meme in her song ‘All Mine.’ Needless to say, Doja’s expletive-ridden tweets quickly went viral, attracting no end of discourse from both fans and critics about what artists got featured in the game and those who missed out. Others were quick to remind her that GTA 5 added new songs to its radio station later in the game’s lifetime, so there’s still a chance that she might get to be in the game at some point further down the line. “They added newer songs on the radio later in GTA 5, so there’s still a chance sis,” one user commented . “You’re actually a gamer, too, that’s why I feel bad,” another lamented . “They added music over time to GTA 5. This is a slight $3 price drop from earlier this month and the lowest price I've seen in a while. The 512GB model is also on sale for $99.99. Are these the lowest prices ever ? No. Are there cheaper memory cards out there? Yes . But if you're looking for a memory card that we've personally tested and recommend , you won't find a better deal right now. Samsung Nintendo Switch Memory Cards on Sale for Black Friday The Switch 2 only comes with 256GB of onboard storage and it will run out faster than you think. If you have a standard MicroSD card from your previous Switch, it won't work on the Switch 2. Although the two might look similar, the MicroSD Express card is much faster than its predecessor. The Samsung P9 model boasts transfer speeds of up to 800MB/s. Quite a few games have now been released for the Switch 2 and some of them require an enormous amount of space. Final Fantasy 14 is the most gigabyte-hungry game to date, requiring about 117GB all by itself. That game alone takes up half of the Switch 2's internal storage capacity. Other plus-sized games include Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade (90GB), Split Fiction (70GB), Cyberpunk 2077 (60GB), and Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment (44GB). The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time tops out at about 27GB. Nowadays it's completely possible to download just three or four games and find yourself completely out of onboard storage. items.title: This Discounted Hylian Shield Backpack Has a Laptop Slot and Plenty of Room for Accessories
items.content_text: The Amazon Black Friday sale officially kicked off today, offering dozens of discounts on all of our favorite nerdy things. Right in time for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, one of the coolest on-theme pieces of Zelda apparel is the Hylian Shield novelty backpack. It's currently $48.99 during Black Friday, saving you 30% off of the usual $69.99 sticker price. This makes a great Zelda gift for kids or for any convention-goers who are looking for a fun way to store their merch. You could even take it to work if you're feeling so bold. The backpack is a bit larger than it looks in pictures, measuring in at 22in. tall, 18in. wide, and 4in. deep, so there's plenty of room for it to actually be practical. There's even a laptop slot on the inside like you'd expect from a normal backpack, as well as smaller accessory compartments for things like portable chargers or a Hookshot . There's a top handle and adjustable straps as well, but unfortunately no water bottle pockets on the outside. The Hylian Shield exterior itself is made of a 3D rubber, so it's pretty sturdy. With the recent release of the Ocarina of Time remake, interest in the game is at an all-time high. IGN's Logan Plant said the remake "skillfully melds the world and dungeon design of classic Zeldas with the movement and presentation of its more recent games, creating both a beautiful retelling of a legend and a rich adventure that stands on its own" in his 9 out of 10 review . If you're playing the game right now and haven't already located the shield yourself, take a look at IGN's guide on how to find it . Ocarina of Time Graphic Tees Are Also on Sale For even more Ocarina of Time apparel, Amazon also has dozens of Zelda-themed graphic t-shirts on sale for Black Friday. Many of them are Ocarina of Time themed, although focused on the original N64 release. There isn't any official remake merch quite yet, but you can bet we'll cover those if they're ever announced.
